bloques.titulo: In this case, the Commission has not considered that the Commission should be able to take the necessary measures to ensure that the measures are implemented in accordance with the provisions of the Treaty.
texto: To respond to something that is already known or that the other just said: phrase in normal form + **なら**: **にほん へ いく なら、 わたし も いきます** (if you go to Japan, I will also go).
This is different from the information already known here.
**なら** is added directly to the name or adjective in -∞: **ひま なら** (if you have time) / **学生 なら** (if you are a student).
**です** is not added before **なら**; forms such as **学生でしたら** can be used in a courteous record.

filas: nombre o adjetivo en -な + なら
学生 なら / ひま なら
